basic_details.short_information: The Indian Farmers Fertiliser Cooperative Limited (IFFCO) has released a recruitment notification for the posts of Data Entry Operator and Chief Manager / Senior Manager (Administration) at its New Delhi office. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official IFFCO recruitment portal on or before 26 July 2026. This article covers complete details of IFFCO Recruitment 2026, including vacancy details, eligibility criteria, age limit, salary, selection process, and the online application link.

content_sections.heading: IFFCO Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
content_sections.text: Last date to apply online: 26 July 2026 The official notification does not mention the notification release date or the online test/interview dates. Candidates are advised to keep checking the official website for further updates.

content_sections.heading: IFFCO Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for IFFCO Recruitment 2026 must meet the educational qualification, work experience, and age limit criteria specified for each post below. Data Entry Operator: More than 3 years of post-qualification experience, with in-depth knowledge of Administration Operations and proficiency in computers and their applications. Chief Manager / Senior Manager (Administration): 10 to 20 years of post-qualification experience, with in-depth knowledge of Admin. Operations and proficiency in computers and their applications. Procurement of goods and services, local purchases, handling tenders, contracts, AMCs, and disposal of assets Knowledge of accounts handling and general administration Good communication and negotiation skills Proficiency in MS-Office Knowledge of Hindi and English

rows.qualification_required: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) with 55% and above, along with a Proficiency Certificate in Computer
Graduate from a recognised University/Institute with an aggregate of 60% marks and a two-year full-time regular MBA degree from a recognised University/Institute, OR Ex-Defence Officer

5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC

content_sections.heading: IFFCO Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be required to appear for a computer-based Online Test, or as otherwise decided by IFFCO. Only shortlisted candidates from the test will be called for a personal interview. Relaxation in eligibility criteria may be granted at the discretion of the Competent Authority. Selected candidates must clear a medical examination as per IFFCO's standards before final selection.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify a list of documents required at the time of application or interview. Candidates are advised to check the official website or wait for further communication from IFFCO regarding document requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for IFFCO Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official IFFCO careers portal: careers.iffco-recruitments.in Find the notification for Data Entry Operator or Chief Manager / Senior Manager (Administration), as applicable. Read the eligibility criteria carefully before proceeding. Fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and experience details. Upload documents as required on the portal and submit the application before the last date. Keep a copy or printout of the submitted application for future reference. The last date to apply online for IFFCO Recruitment 2026 is 26 July 2026.

content_sections.heading: IFFCO Recruitment 2026 - Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The selected candidate's position is transferable to any existing or future establishment of IFFCO or its subsidiaries. Knowledge of Hindi and English is required for both posts. Relaxation in eligibility norms may be granted at the discretion of the Competent Authority. A medical examination as per IFFCO's standards is mandatory before final selection. Candidates should apply well before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IFFCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for IFFCO Recruitment 2026 is 26 July 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IFFCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 2 vacancies: 1 post of Data Entry Operator and 1 post of Chief Manager / Senior Manager (Administration).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for the IFFCO Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) degree with 55% and above, along with a Proficiency Certificate in Computer.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for the IFFCO Chief Manager / Senior Manager (Administration) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate with 60% aggregate marks and a two-year full-time regular MBA degree from a recognised University/Institute, or be an Ex-Defence Officer.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IFFCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is not more than 30 years for Data Entry Operator, and between 31 years and 45 years for Chief Manager / Senior Manager (Administration), as on 1 July 2026. Age relaxation of 5 years is given to SC/ST and 3 years to OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for IFFCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves a computer-based online test (or as decided by IFFCO), followed by a personal interview for shortlisted candidates, and a medical examination before final selection.
